ios.desc:
Say hello to bunq – the mobile bank that's there for you at every chapter of your life! Whether exploring new countries, building your dream business, or managing family life, bunq helps you grow your wealth, spend, and budget effortlessly. Open your account in just 5 minutes and start your 30-day free trial today.

Our Plans

bunq Free - €0/month
Get started with essential banking.

• 3 Bank Accounts to get you started
• 1 Digital Card with Apple Pay support
• Scheduled Payments and AutoAccept for requests
• Earn 3.51% interest on USD/GBP savings
• Invest in stocks with ease
• Buy and sell cryptocurrencies in the EEA
• Save up to 90% on roaming costs with an eSIM from bunq

Business features:
• Accept contactless payments with Tap to Pay
• Integration with 50+ bookkeeping tools

bunq Core - €3.99/month
A bank account for everyday use.

All bunq Free benefits, plus:
• 5 Bank Accounts for your everyday needs
• 1 Physical Card included
• Personalize your Physical Card to make it uniquely yours
• Shared account access
• Add loyalty cards for quick access
• Unlimited ZeroFX
• 24/7 SOS Hotline for emergencies

Business features:
• Co-founder access
• Shared account access
• Bookkeeping integrations

bunq Pro - €9.99/month
The bank account that makes budgeting easy.

All bunq Core benefits, plus:
• 25 Bank Accounts for effortless budgeting
• 3 Physical Cards and 25 Digital Cards included
• Personalized budgeting insights and income organiser
• 5 fee-free foreign currency payments per month
• Secondary PIN for multiple accounts on one card
• 20% discount on stock trading fees
• Student offer: pay €0 per month

Business features:
• Add up to 3 employees
• Company Cards (debit or credit) and Tap to Pay access
• AutoVAT

bunq Elite - €18.99/month
The account for your international lifestyle.

All bunq Pro benefits, plus:
• Worldwide Travel Insurance
• 10 fee-free foreign currency payments per month
• 8GB worldwide data 
• 50% discount on stock trading fees

Business features:
• Add up to 10 employees
• 500 fee-free transactions per year

Your security = Our priority
Boost your bank security with two-factor authentication and 100% control of cards.

Your deposits = Fully protected
Your money is insured up to €100,000 by the Deposit Guarantee Scheme (DGS).

Invest in the bunq app through our partners. Investing involves risks, including potential loss. bunq does not provide trading advice. Manage your investments at your own risk.

bunq is authorized by the Dutch Cent

quotes.text:
I've seen apps completely ditch their current target group for something else (like bunq, a Dutch fintech company that targeted banking Nerds (we have an API!), then pivoted to Hipsters (we have #insta inside our banking app!)), that go from 4.8 to 1.8 stars over-night and boom, 2 days later they're back at 4.9 claiming users love the new app (oh and we hid the forum a bit deeper in the app, we don't want new users to come across that helpful community that turned into a list of complainers over night!)

I don't trust the appstore reviews anymore.

I mean how can this be: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/bunq/id1021178150#see-all/reviews ?
quotes.story_title: Apple Podcasts suddenly became a five-star app

quotes.text:
And the Play Store for that matter [0]. They dropped hugely after pushing their v3. For days they were below 2 stars on the Play Store. But then they bounced back in a period of a couple of days to well over 4 stars.

Is there any analytics that can be done by 3rd parties? This is very strange, right?

[0]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bunq.android&hl=nl&gl=US
